title: More freedom
notes: Song structure: build each song section by section, and pick its tempo, mood and sound.
Write songs of your own any time, in a notebook, and put them on any album as extra tracks.
Set an album's track order yourself in the Studio.
Choose when tour prep starts, from right after release to a four-week crunch.
Choose how to do videos, announcements, release-week TV, signings, costumes, casting, setlists and mastering.
Optional opportunities now turn up on This Week, each with its own choices.
